scope: Independent static acceptance of the exact small read-only tray remainder command. This accepts inspection and recovery of an already pinned raw failure record, not cache deletion or cleanup completion.
selectors: Exactly C:/Users/YossiMH/AppData/Local/bead-me-up-scotty/tray/session-EQDYF7 and tray-smoke/session-0KObLb are inspected. Both paths are independently present in the retained actual process arguments for the failed Session run.

Directory inspection is shallow and limited to the two literal paths. At most eight names are accepted per directory, and only windows-tray.ps1/windows-tray-click.ps1 may be read. File content is not returned; output contains each observed file's size/hash.

The only task-definition input is the exact 100,788-byte private inventory SHA 97971b4fb451e6be8839d8ca7e37a8d49f486d1b3b81aaeaf754293d3e7cbd4f. The code then selects exactly one row named ChatGPT-BeadEditing-TrayHost-20261127-2889282bfcec.

The Arguments selector does not execute XML text. Its EvidenceDirectory regex permits only a single alphanumeric/hyphen child under the fixed F:/Dev/.bead-edit-20261111 root, followed by a delimiter. It cannot admit separators, traversal, drive changes or arbitrary roots.

The regex accepts the explicit unquoted Windows-backslash argument form. A different leading quoting or XML form fails closed before the result read; there is no alternate directory scan or guessed fallback. The exact private XML remains on the PC and was not recovered or independently asserted by this cloud review.

The selected result.json must be at most 1 MiB and exactly SHA 0974b117a9586541024de04f1d2b4c87db59362dfd37556d57f355dbee815370 before any raw bytes are returned. That identity agrees with the retained earlier TrayHost failure record.
read_and_output_bounds: Each path is lstat-checked up its non-root ancestors; symlink paths and nonordinary target/parent shapes refuse. ENOENT on an exact cache directory reports absence, while other failures stop the command.
Reads compare dev, ino, size, mtimeNs and ctimeNs before/after and require the returned length to match. Cache files and inventory are capped at 128 KiB; the old result is capped at 1 MiB.

Only the already hash-accepted old result is compressed, with gzip level 1. Its raw and gzip size/hash accompany gzip+base64. The successful JSON line is capped at 60,000 characters; all selected paths/names and payload encoding are ASCII, so this also bounds its UTF-8 bytes before the newline.

The two cache observations are evidence only. They do not accept ownership of any unexpected file or authorize deletion; the later reviewer must compare exact intended per-folder filenames/hashes and fresh process absence.

resource_contract.required_outer_execution: Use root's bounded direct Node invocation with a finite outer timeout, preferably 20 seconds, and enough complete stdout capacity for the 60,001-byte maximum successful line. No extra PowerShell host or child process is needed.
resource_contract.limit_scope: The source checks are cooperative around local metadata/read operations. They are not an independent timer able to interrupt a blocked synchronous filesystem call. The bounded outer invocation remains necessary; actual timing/RSS and returned bytes must be reconciled.

accepted_for: Exact read-only inspection/recovery from the two known cache directories and hash-pinned older result, under the stated bounded Node invocation.
reviewer_activity: Read exact source and retained local evidence only. No PC call, product execution, test suite, mutation or source edit.
